Sandbox_LiveWire_LinkVerticalRange_toolt: Maximum floor difference for equipment connections and inverter coupling, above or below. 0 = same floor only.
Sandbox_LiveWire_PowerScale_tooltip: Multiplies the consumption of every appliance, on top of the consumption profile (1 = no change).
Sandbox_LiveWire_ConsumptionProfile_tool: Power drawn by switched-on appliances. Game values: the engine's own values (light 2 W, fridge-freezer 130 W). Realistic 1993: average household draws of the time (light 60 W, TV 80 W, cooker 2,000 W). Ultra-realistic 1993: older, hungrier appliances (light 100 W, cooker 3,000 W, dryer 5,000 W). Comfort: half the game values.
Sandbox_LiveWire_SolarMultiplier_tooltip: Multiplier of the solar panel production.
Sandbox_LiveWire_WindMultiplier_tooltip: Multiplier of the wind turbine production.
Sandbox_LiveWire_HydroMultiplier_tooltip: Multiplier of the water wheel production.
Sandbox_LiveWire_BatteryCapacityMultipli: Multiplier of the capacity of every battery.
Sandbox_LiveWire_DeviceWearMultiplier_to: Wear of sources, inverters and equipment. 0 disables it.
Sandbox_LiveWire_InverterNoiseRadius_too: Radius in tiles of the hum heard by zombies. 0 = silent.
Sandbox_LiveWire_LinkRange_tooltip: Maximum distance in tiles between a device and its inverter.
Sandbox_LiveWire_PumpRange_tooltip: Radius in tiles around a water pump where its sinks, showers, baths and toilets are supplied.
Sandbox_LiveWire_WirePerTiles_tooltip: One electric wire is used per this many tiles of cable. 0 = free cabling.
Sandbox_LiveWire_StormDamage_tooltip: Thunderstorms and very strong winds damage solar panels and wind turbines.
Sandbox_LiveWire_XPMultiplier_tooltip: Multiplier of the experience given by Live Wire actions.
Sandbox_LiveWire_SkillGates_tooltip: When disabled, no Electrical level is required.
Sandbox_LiveWire_SimulateUnloaded_toolti: Production, consumption and wear go on when no player is nearby.
Sandbox_LiveWire_BackupStartPercent_tool: A backup generator starts when the batteries fall below this percentage.
Sandbox_LiveWire_BackupStopPercent_toolt: The backup generator stops once the batteries reach this percentage. The stop threshold is automatically raised to at least 5 percentage points above the start threshold.
Sandbox_LiveWire_EquipmentLootMultiplier: Live Wire equipment and parts loot multiplier

Multiplies loot weights only for Live Wire equipment and parts (solar cells, blades and masts) (1-20, default 5). Vanilla items and their loot weights are unchanged. Software disks keep their existing rate. Restart required; future loot rolls only, no refill of searched containers. Vanilla loot settings still apply.
Sandbox_LiveWire_SolarOrientation_toolti: Panel facing changes output and peak production time.
Sandbox_LiveWire_SolarDirt_tooltip: Dust accumulates on panels. Rain and manual cleaning remove it.
Sandbox_LiveWire_BatteryCold_tooltip: Cold reduces accessible capacity in outdoor banks. The reserve returns on thawing.
Sandbox_LiveWire_LiveWorkRisk_tooltip: Enabled by default. Shock risk: 50%% at Electrical 0, falling to zero at 6. Burns the screwdriver hand and drops held items. Switch off the master inverter: the main breaker does not make maintenance safe.
